lines: 因我们行事为人是凭着信心，
不是凭着眼见。
for we walk by faith
not by sight.
因我们行事为人是凭着信心，
不是凭着眼见。
因我們行事為人是憑着信心，
不是憑着眼見。
for we walk by faith
not by sight.
(For we are walking by faith
not by seeing,)
耶和华是我的牧者，
我必不至缺乏。
Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
耶和华是我的牧者，
我必不至缺乏。
耶和華是我的牧者，
我必不至缺乏。
Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
<A Psalm. Of David.> The Lord takes care of me as his sheep; I will not be without any good thing.
你要专心仰赖耶和华，
不可倚靠自己的聪明，
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart
and don’t lean on your own understanding.
你要专心仰赖耶和华，
不可倚靠自己的聪明，
你要專心仰賴耶和華，
不可倚靠自己的聰明，
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart
and don’t lean on your own understanding.
Put all your hope in God
not looking to your reason for support.
你要保守你心，胜过保守一切，
因为一生的果效是由心发出。
Keep your heart with all diligence
for out of it is the wellspring of life.
你要保守你心，胜过保守一切，
因为一生的果效是由心发出。
你要保守你心，勝過保守一切，
因為一生的果效是由心發出。
Keep your heart with all diligence
for out of it is the wellspring of life.
And keep watch over your heart with all care; so you will have life.
凡劳苦担重担的人可以到我这里来，
我就使你们得安息。
“Come to me
all you who labor and are heavily burdened
and I will give you rest.
凡劳苦担重担的人可以到我这里来，
我就使你们得安息。
凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裏來，
我就使你們得安息。
“Come to me
all you who labor and are heavily burdened
and I will give you rest.
Come to me
all you who are troubled and weighted down with care
and I will give you rest.
你们要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，
在遍地上也被尊崇。
“Be still
and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
你们要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，
在遍地上也被尊崇。
你們要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，
在遍地上也被尊崇。
“Be still
and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations
I will be honoured through all the earth.
应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，
和感谢，将你们所要的告诉神。
In nothing be anxious
but in everything
by prayer and petition with thanksgiving
let your requests be made known to God.
应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，
和感谢，将你们所要的告诉神。
應當一無掛慮，只要凡事藉着禱告、祈求，
和感謝，將你們所要的告訴神。
In nothing be anxious
but in everything
by prayer and petition with thanksgiving
let your requests be made known to God.
Have no cares; but in everything with prayer and praise put your requests before God.
我们晓得万事都互相效力，
叫爱神的人得益处，
就是按他旨意被召的人。
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God
to those who are called according to his purpose.
我们晓得万事都互相效力，
叫爱神的人得益处，
就是按他旨意被召的人。
我們曉得萬事都互相效力，
叫愛神的人得益處，
就是按他旨意被召的人。
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God
to those who are called according to his purpose.
And we are conscious that all things are working together for good to those who have love for God
and have been marked out by his purpose.
神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，
叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，
反得永生。
For God so loved the world
that he gave his one and only Son
that whoever believes in him should not perish
but have eternal life.
神爱世人，甚至将他的独生子赐给他们，
叫一切信他的，不至灭亡，
反得永生。
神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，
叫一切信他的，不至滅亡，
反得永生。
For God so loved the world
that he gave his one and only Son
that whoever believes in him should not perish
but have eternal life.
For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son
so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.
你要专心仰赖耶和华，
不可倚靠自己的聪明，
在你一切所行的事上都要认定他，
他必指引你的路。
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart
and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him
and he will make your paths straight.
你要专心仰赖耶和华，
不可倚靠自己的聪明，
在你一切所行的事上都要认定他，
他必指引你的路。
你要專心仰賴耶和華，
不可倚靠自己的聰明，
在你一切所行的事上都要認定他，
他必指引你的路。
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart
and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him
and he will make your paths straight.
Put all your hope in God
not looking to your reason for support.
In all your ways give ear to him
and he will make straight your footsteps.
不住的祷告，
Pray without ceasing.
不住的祷告，
不住的禱告，
Pray without ceasing.
Keep on with your prayers.
「不可杀人。
“You shall not murder.
「不可杀人。
「不可殺人。
“You shall not murder.
Do not put anyone to death without cause.
你们要回想罗得的妻子。
Remember Lot’s wife!
你们要回想罗得的妻子。
你們要回想羅得的妻子。
Remember Lot’s wife!
Keep in mind Lot's wife.
「不可奸淫。
“You shall not commit adultery.
「不可奸淫。
「不可姦淫。
“You shall not commit adultery.
Do not be false to the married relation.
耶和华，我的力量啊，
我爱你！
I love you
Yahweh
my strength.
耶和华，我的力量啊，
我爱你！
耶和華，我的力量啊，
我愛你！
I love you
Yahweh
my strength.
我们爱，因为神先爱我们。
We love him
because he first loved us.
我们爱，因为神先爱我们。
我們愛，因為神先愛我們。
We love him
because he first loved us.
We have the power of loving
because he first had love for us.
「你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。
If you love me
keep my commandments.
「你们若爱我，就必遵守我的命令。
「你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。
If you love me
keep my commandments.
If you have love for me
you will keep my laws.
当面的责备强如背地的爱情。
Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
当面的责备强如背地的爱情。
當面的責備強如背地的愛情。
Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
Better is open protest than love kept secret.
我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。
When I am afraid
I will put my trust in you.
我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。
我懼怕的時候要倚靠你。
When I am afraid
I will put my trust in you.
In the time of my fear
I will have faith in you.
二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？
Do two walk together
unless they have agreed?
二人若不同心，岂能同行呢？
二人若不同心，豈能同行呢？
Do two walk together
unless they have agreed?
Is it possible for two to go walking together
if not by agreement?
